ResearchProjectDef.label: biological cultivation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Reverse-engineer the growth media, tissue regulation and bioelectric control principles visible in recovered Wraith capture technology. This is the first step toward cultured biomass and living Wraith systems.

ResearchProjectDef.label: feeding ecology
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study how Wraith life-force demand, biological prey availability and controlled feeding interact over long periods without reducing feeding to an ordinary food need.

ResearchProjectDef.label: feeding resistance
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop treatments and biochemical countermeasures that reduce the long-term damage caused by repeated Wraith feeding and life-force manipulation.

ResearchProjectDef.label: bioelectric organs
ResearchProjectDef.description: Adapt Wraith tissue engineering into stable living organs capable of storing, regulating and distributing electrical energy.

ResearchProjectDef.label: living weapons
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow stable weapon structures that combine cultured tissue with controllable bioelectric discharge and Wraith capture technology.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced carapace
ResearchProjectDef.description: Use controlled living growth to produce hardened, self-supporting Wraith structural tissue suitable for advanced armour and organic machinery.

ResearchProjectDef.label: cloning infrastructure
ResearchProjectDef.description: Scale Wraith tissue cultivation into controlled growth chambers capable of sustaining whole-body development and bounded population replacement.

ResearchProjectDef.label: forbidden hybridization
ResearchProjectDef.description: Combine Wraith growth methods with non-Wraith biology to create unstable hybrid organisms. The process is powerful, costly and deliberately separated from ordinary cloning.

ResearchProjectDef.label: hive architecture
ResearchProjectDef.description: Integrate cultured biomass, bioelectric organs and cloning systems into persistent living infrastructure suitable for a mature Wraith hive.
